episodes.synopsis: Half a month after the battle on Treasure Island, Kogane, Kinoa, Shizuru, and Hiiragi ride through the lively streets of Taiwan in a taxi... but Azuma got stuck in immigration and had to catch a later flight. The girls are thrilled by the sights of their first visit to Taiwan, but Hiiragi reminds them that they're there to find the body of the Buranki that went missing when Treasure Island fell. Just then, a headless Buranki shows up at the airport where Azuma is soon due to arrive...
episodes.title: Black Oubu

episodes.synopsis: Guy praises Leticia for destroying most of the headless Buranki lurking around Europe. This irritates Kaoruko, who wants Guy to acknowledge her as the number one heart user. Then, when Kaoruko finds out Maxim was given a special mission, Guy tells her that she must first demonstrate her talent as a heart user. Still, Kaoruko boldly laughs, convinced that she will be the one to protect the world with Oubu.
episodes.title: The False Heart

episodes.synopsis: As Azuma and Kaoruko stare each other down, their respective limbs battle it out with their Bubuki. Angus is on the defensive against Kinoa's fierce attacks, Shepherd is overwhelmed by Shizuru, Joan can't get a single attack in against Kogane, and Lakshmi struggles against the cooperative relationship between Hiiragi and Iwatooshi. As the members of the Asian team, who have been under the complete control of their leader Justin, watch the Japanese team fighting without being tied down by their leader, they start to show signs of changing...
episodes.title: The Right Hand`s Scar

episodes.synopsis: The Buranki Entei flies freely through the sky... and the one controlling it is not Reoko, but Kaoruko. Demokratia, led by Guy, has used its technology to make Entei recognize Kaoruko as Reoko. Guy then tells Kaoruko that there is a traitor among them in Demokratia, but she's unable to conceal her shock when told that the traitor is a fellow Bubuki user and ordered to eliminate them.
episodes.title: The Hunter`s Bullet

episodes.synopsis: In a room somewhere deep in Demokratia's island fortress, Kaoruko discovers the identity of the Bubuki users that Guy had called "traitors." She asks Double why she never knows what's going on and why all this happened, but Double only tells her that if she doesn't live up to Guy's expectations and eliminate the approaching Azuma and Oubu, she'll receive the same treatment as the traitors... and that there are some things she doesn't need to know.
episodes.title: The Island Fortress

episodes.synopsis: Kaoruko has been trying to find a way to see her father again ever since he left her at a boarding school in Taiwan. One day, Guy tells Kaoruko that her father reunited with her mother by going up to Treasure Island in a Buranki that still had its brain. Sensing that Kaoruko, despite her brave act, really wants to see her parents again, Guy makes a proposal that will allow him to use her feelings to serve his purposes...
episodes.title: The Butterfly and the Gallows

episodes.synopsis: Peaceful scenery passes by outside the car window, but Azuma has no idea that the kind old man giving him a lift toward the island fortress is Guy himself. Meanwhile, back at their hideout, Kogane and the others are being attacked, and Matobai and Tsuwabuki realize that Azuma is gone. Hiiragi and Kinoa say that until he comes back with Kaoruko, they're on their own, but Matobai's subdued gaze is fixed on the Buranki Batolov.
episodes.title: Older Brother and Younger Sister

episodes.synopsis: The Buranki Epimew soars over hills and plains, faster and lighter than the wind, disappearing from sight in an instant only to rise high into the sky again. In the cockpit, Laetitia is delighted by the sight of whooper swans flying by. Since she lives her life in a wheelchair, the world as seen from the birds' point of view is wondrous to her. Epimew flies past the birds and shoots high above the clouds, higher and higher. What's going through Laetitia's mind as she finally reaches the heights of space?
episodes.title: The Rebellious Limb

episodes.synopsis: After rescuing Reoko from Guy's island fortress, Azuma and the others rest of the Japanese crew flies back to Japan... but the moment they're over Japanese waters, a flying craft approaches at high speed. From the heart waveform, Matobai determines that it's Mega-lala. Azuma leaps out to the hull of their flying boat to face the Buranki, and a battle between two heart users who could have been great friends if not for the involvement of Bubuki and Buranki begins.
episodes.title: Swan Song

episodes.synopsis: Inheritance: if one were to express it with a different word, it would be "curse." Guy, an inheritor of a heart Bubuki, was released from the curse through the only possible method... only to have it return to him in a sudden turn of events. In anguish, Guy made up his mind to eliminate from this world all the Buranki that had tainted human blood and placed this detestable curse on them, thereby returning the world to untainted human hands. Now, 16 years later, everyone watches the sky as a huge comet approaches Earth...
episodes.title: The Comet Opens Its Eyes

episodes.synopsis: The massive Deus Magna seems to pierce the heavens as it makes its appearance amidst a raging storm, and inside its cranium is the enemy, Guy. The Buranki Batolov and Mega-lala, along with Zampaza piloted by Kaoruko, wield the Bubuki from Laetitia's fallen Buranki as they charge forward to stop him, each for their own individual reasons. But no matter how fiercely they attack Deus Magna, they can't even leave a mark. Meanwhile, inside Deus Magna's body, Azuma and his team enter the battle with Oubu to try to stop Guy and save Reoko.
episodes.title: The Gentle Giants of the Galaxy

episodes.synopsis: It's been a year. Peace has returned, and everyone is back to living their old lives again. Azuma has started living on his own and now attends the same high school as Kogane. All Buranki controlled by Guy's Demokratia have been handed over to government-managed companies. As he watches the news over breakfast and opens a letter from Epizo, Azuma can't help but feel how much quieter his life is now.
episodes.title: The Adventurers

La storia ruota attorno al giovane Renton Thurston, che entra a far parte del Gekko-Go, aeronave della trecentotreesima Unità indipendente dell'Esercito di Liberazione dell'Umanità. Nella sua prima missione, Renton deve recuperare un soggetto ritenuto molto importante dall'esercito, ma con suo grande stupore scopre che tale soggetto è Eureka, una ragazza che è stata sua amica d'infanzia...

episodes.synopsis: Blade is an ex-hero who just wants to make friends and live an ordinary life. But on his first day at Rosewood Academy, he catches the eye of the school's number-one student, Earnest Flaming, who wants to get Blade expelled!
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Blade is asked by Earnest to look after Sophie, who always practices by herself during class. But as he grows closer to Sophie, he discovers that beneath her aloof exterior and powerful fists lies a dark, disturbing secret...
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: A dragon is on the loose in Rosewood Academy, but Blade quickly subdues it with a well-placed punch. To everyone's surprise, the dragon then shapeshifts into the form of a human child... who seems to think Blade is her parent?!
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Earnest and the student body challenge Cu to battle, to prove that they are worthy of being friends with her. Is the combined might of Rosewood Academy's heroes-in-training enough take down this fearsome dragon, fair and square?!
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: One day, Claire asks Blade to do a favor for Maria, a quiet, clumsy girl who happened to take part in the battle against Cu. As it so happens, Maria's request for Blade is none other than... to kill her?!
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: While exploring the royal capital, Blade comes across Dione, a centaur who once fought alongside him as a hero. As it turns out, Dione was tasked by the king with transporting what happens to be some very special cargo...
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: The king unveils a new virtual reality training program at Rosewood Academy. However, it inadvertently creates a rift in the friend group made up of Claire, Yessica, Clay, and Kassim. Now it's up to Blade to patch things up!
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious robot shows up on the Rosewood Academy campus. Claire quickly befriends the robot, who she dubs Iona, and decides to enlist help from her friends to accomplish Iona's mission: to eradicate Blade!
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: The Superorganism Suppression Committee is a motley crew of Rosewood Academy students, united by a common goal: to defeat the superorganism himself, Blade. But this fearsome Great Hero isn't about to go down without a fight!
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Earnest decides that a birthday meal for Blade would be the perfect gift, so the king arranges for a trip down to the Royal Pantry, a sprawling wilderness inhabited by vicious foodstuff. Now, it's eat or be eaten!
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: One day during training, Blade is suddenly attacked by Sophie. This Sophie, however, turns out to be one of five identical clone assassins, who will do anything it takes to murder the Great Hero and prove their superiority!
episodes.title: La serie Sophie (Parte 1)

episodes.synopsis: Blade wakes up to find that Sophie has left Rosewood Academy in the middle of the night, in pursuit of her clones. Now, it's up to Blade and his friends to find a way to save both Sophie and her sisters from their cruel fates...
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Molto tempo fa, un potente signore dei demoni governò il popolo fino a quando arrivò un eroe altrettanto potente a sconfiggerlo. Per contrastare le minacce future fu creata la Rosewood Academy, una scuola per eroi in formazione. Oggi alla Rosewood Academy si iscrive solo il meglio del meglio, e Arnest Flaming è la migliore di tutti. Arnest è la studentessa più importante della scuola, è una ragazza rispettosa, e viene soprannominata "Imperatrice della fiamma". Un giorno, nel corridoio della scuola, ha un incontro irritante con un ragazzo scanzonato che non ha mai visto prima, nonostante sembri avere poteri tali da eguagliare i suoi. Il ragazzo si presenta solo come Blade e Arnest scopre presto che non solo il ragazzo è un nuovo studente appena trasferito, ma anche che lei è stata personalmente richiesta dal Re per aiutare il nuovo ragazzo ad ambientarsi nella vita quotidiana della Rosewood Academy.
info.title: Classroom for Heroes

episodes.synopsis: After having moved away several years earlier, Saku Oyagi returns to his hometown to begin his high school life. Saku has always enjoyed simply staying home and reading books, but his childhood friend Mihoshi Akeno used to forcibly take him outside to take part in various activities. On their last day together, Mihoshi fell out of a tree, causing Saku to go to the hospital with a broken arm, and since then Saku has never wanted to see Mihoshi again. However on his first day at high school, he meets Mihoshi as she is trying to recruit members into the astronomy club. Saku attempts to avoid her as well he can, but after Saku realizes that the reason Mihoshi did not see him off years ago was because she too was in the hospital, Saku makes up with Mihoshi, and joins the astronomy club.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: No one besides Saku has joined the astronomy club, so recruiting tactics are still going on. Hime Makita from Saku's class is annoyed that Mihoshi and other astronomy members come to their class so often when she would rather spend some time alone with Saku. Hime met him on the bus to take the entrance exam of the school they now attend, and was thrilled to see they were put in the same class. After Hime finds out that Saku and Mihoshi are not dating, Hime joins the astronomy club, which finally becomes officially recognized. Another day, the astronomy club members go stargazing far from the city's lights.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Mihoshi has been bothering Saku too much lately so he takes a break from the club and goes to the library where he meets the student council president Fumie Kotozuka by chance. After talking with her, Saku realizes Mihoshi is merely expressing her feelings honestly like she always has and Saku agrees to accompany her with stargazing. However, the rainy season begins causing Mihoshi to get very depressed over the cloudy skies. With Saku's suggestion, the astronomy club goes to the planetarium and are shown the summer constellations. After the rain ends, Mihoshi wants the club to go on a summer stargazing camp.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: The president of the astronomy club organizes the stargazing camp, but before they go, Hime becomes agitated that Mihoshi is all over Saku, and she yells out asking what she thinks of him. Mihoshi replies that she loves him, but follows it up saying that she loves everyone else too. After they arrive near a lake in norther Japan, they find the literature club also came for a camp, and while they get to stay in a large resort-type building, the astronomy club members are left to stay in a run down place. Mihoshi cleans it up and the members take a nap so as to wake up at night for stargazing. Saku and Hime are still concerned about what happened earlier, but they later clear it up between each other. The astronomy club spends the entire night stargazing and watch the sunrise.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Fumie finds the astronomy club members sleeping in the same room after they collapsed from exhaustion the previous night, and she forbids them from taking part in club activities for one night. The next day, three guys hit on Hime and two literature club members, and Fumie tries to interfere at first, but when Saku goes to help, he trips and falls into the guy's fist. Mihoshi and Hime manage to take care of the three guys, and Saku is taken inside and cared for, though he only has a small cut. While the other astronomy club members are taking a bath, Fumie talks with Saku about the astronomy club's activities and they decide to invite the literature club members the next night to show them what the astronomy club does at night. Hime takes care of pointing out several constellations and the Milky Way, and everyone enjoys the night of stargazing.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: The new semester starts and on the bus to school Saku notices a tall man also getting off at the school. During the welcome back ceremony, the man that Saku saw earlier is introduced as a new teacher named Nozomu Soma who is in charge of Saku's class and world history. Mihoshi calls him "So-nii" in front of everyone and rumors abound as to what their relationship is. Later, Soma becomes the astronomy club's adviser and he explains to the others how Mihoshi's father was his professor at college and also the club adviser for their astronomy club. Soma wants the club to do a planetarium for the upcoming cultural festival and they get in the top three in a popularity contest in exhibits, the club will get more funding. Saku becomes annoyed at Mihoshi's and Soma's relationship and is approached by Fumie to help with the literature club.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Despite initially going to refuse, Saku ends up agreeing to help the literature club. Mihoshi acts cheerful without him there, but is still troubled by his absence. Meanwhile, the astronomy club has their hands full with making the planetarium. Mihoshi suddenly hugs Saku one day after school and rumors spread after some athletic club members see them together with Soma. Fumie becomes concerned that Saku has been helping the literature club too much and that he may be concerned about the rumors regarding him, Mihoshi and Soma. Hime gives Saku a journal she compiled about the planetarium's construction. Saku feels re-energized about the astronomy club and goes back to help.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: The cultural festival begins, though initially no one is coming to see the planetarium. After Haruko from the city planetarium arrives, she helps to bring in the people and the planetarium is well received by viewers for the rest of the day. Mihoshi thanks Saku for everything he has done for the club and is thankful that she has not caused him any trouble while he was helping the literature club. After the festival, the club members are distraught at the thought of dismantling the planetarium, but eventually take it down. The astronomy club was not able to win any prizes for the festival and thus still do not have enough money to even buy a telescope. Sayo takes the club to her family's Buddhist temple and perform a small moon festival. The astronomy club receives a video letter from the president of the astronomy club of Nogishiro High School in the same prefecture as Sōei High School inviting the club to the Autumn Stargazing Conference of the Prefectural High School Astronomy Network.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Mihoshi and the other members are excited about the Autumn Stargazing Conference, and are surprised at the size of Nogishiro High School along with the number of members in their astronomy club. After the sun sets, everyone splits into groups and the process is explained by Nogishiro's astronomy club president Ayumi Ōmi; each group is free to stargaze until the moon sets, upon which each group will begin counting visible stars in a patch of sky to measure the overall brightness of the sky. Ayumi asks Saku to help on patrol around the school and they come across Hime and a second-year named Musa after she overreacts and thought he was trying to assault her. Afterwards, everyone goes back to the roof now that the moon has has set, and Ayumi confesses to Saku that her astronomy club actually only has nine members in it and mostly everyone else is from other clubs. Takeyasu Roma does a narration of the autumn sky myth which everyone loves. Ayumi later confronts Roma and reminds him that they were once members of the same astronomy club at Goshima Science Museum.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: After overhearing Mihoshi and Soma about plans together on the weekend, Saku, Hime and Edogawa follow them around town to find out what is going on, and initially they are out on a date. They eventually follow them to the grave site of Mihoshi's father who died in a car accident and everyone pays their respects. Saku, Hime and Edogawa feel awkward around Mihoshi after this. Fumie tries to give Saku a bookmark souvenir from her school trip to Hokkaido, but her glasses are broken after Saku protects her from a stray baseball. Saku offers to walks her home and on the way they run into two members of the literature club who to take her the rest of the way. Saku gets Fumie's help to set up a shooting star viewing event at school for Mihoshi, who is overcome with emotion over it.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Saku's astronomy club participates in a winter stargazing camp with the girl from Takami Girl's School, who also participated in the Autumn Stargazing Conference. Saku, Edogawa and especially Hime do not dress warm enough, and while Saku and Edogawa brought more warmer clothes, Hime cannot dress in layers with the extra clothes she brought. After spending the first day freezing, Hime goes out at night to go to a local convenience store, but it is already closed by the time she gets there and a blizzard is blowing in. Hime tries to get back to the cabin, but quickly gets lost. The others notice she is gone, and also suspect Mihoshi went out to search for her. With Hime close to freezing to death, Mihoshi finds her and the two wait out the blizzard in a small snow cave. They find they were not far from the cabin and while they are scolded for what they did, everyone is relieved to have them back safely.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: The astronomy club members wake up late the next morning and first spend some time warming up in the outdoor baths. Ayumi Omi notices Roma stressing over studying for university entrance exams, and takes him to buy a study book and then have dinner at a fancy restaurant. The astronomy club members wait until the moon sets on the third night and spend their final night in the mountains stargazing and taking photos. The members use some eyepieces Mihoshi brought to find Saturn, which is an entrancing sight for everyone. The following spring, Mihoshi has succeeded as club president after Roma graduated and entered into university with Ayumi. Everyone puts in more effort this year for recruiting members, since they are now one member short, and are again in danger of getting disbanded.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Il protagonista, Saku, torna nel paese in cui aveva vissuto da bambino e incontra nuovamente una sua vecchia amica d'infanzia, Mihoshi. Il rapporto fra i due non era dei migliori: Mihoshi amava moltissimo guardare le stelle e non perdeva occasione per coinvolgere nelle sue avventure Saku, il quale, da parte sua, avrebbe preferito restarsene a casa a leggere libri; in un'occasione il ragazzo si era perfino rotto un braccio per salvare la sua compagna che era caduta da un albero. A causa di questi trascorsi Saku spera di non dover ancora avere a che fare con lei, ma la sua speranza era destinata a svanire in fretta: Mihoshi lo riconosce subito ed è determinata a migliorare la loro relazione. Per far questo lo costringe ad iscriversi al club di astronomia fondato da lei.
info.title: At The Mercy of The Sky

episodes.synopsis: The rapid explosion of human technology has caused humanity to grow to fear and resent the divinely granted supernatural powers of witches. The witch Chloe and her apprentice, Adonis, find themselves caught in the crosshairs of the Redia Empire.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Adonis uses his newfound freedom to wreak havoc on the city of New Nightmare. His long-practiced written-style summoning magic tears through the Radian citizens while Doroka races to meet up with him.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: The various government institutions of Redia scramble to stop Adonis' rampage. When they go to activate the Magic Photon Suppression Device, Theta, the director of the National Science Agency, shares previously hidden information.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Anna is ultimately successful in her mission and manages to use her magic to fool the Redia Empire long enough to extract Adonis. Adonis is extracted by the witches and witnesses firsthand the state of their society in the wake of their war with humanity.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: As the resurrection ritual comes to completion, Lunamilia is suddenly attacked by the National Security Bureau. The safety of the witches is compromised, and the mito is set ablaze. Adonis and Yamato face off in a revenge-fueled duel.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Doroka finally calls upon her magical powers in an attempt to put an end to the carnage on Lunamilia. As the battle on the moon comes to a close, we discover who's truly in control of the Redia Empire.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Adonis and Doroka find themselves on the planet's surface once again. Still reeling from the carnage on the moon, they encounter some wasteland vagrants who take them in. However, there may be more to these vagrants than expected.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: With Goethe and the witches out of her way, Dorothea ascends to the imperial throne. As she uses her magic to consolidate her power, Shirousagi searches the wastelands for Adonis. Meanwhile, Adonis and Doroka stumble into a seemingly abandoned ghost town.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Adonis and Doroka arrive at the city-state of Mamuta only to find it devoid of human life. Strange stirrings of something far from human echo throughout the city as two opposing parties begin to close in on Adonis and Doroka.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Shirousagi has found Adonis and Doroka with the help of the National Intelligence Agency. He brings the full power of humanity's technology to bear against Adonis and Doroka in a brutal battle.
episodes.title: La vista perduta

episodes.synopsis: Adonis has to face Shirousagi alone while trying to protect an incapacitated Doroka. When his limits are reached, the two of them work together through unsavory means in a desperate attempt to survive.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Empowered by Doroka's Love Spell, Adonis reaches new heights of physical and magical power. He unleashes his magic in a way that fulfils a promise he made to Chloe long ago.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Lu Mingfei è un ragazzo con scarsi risultati scolastici e goffo a livello sociale che viene costantemente rifiutato dalle università. Quando le sue speranze sembrano perse, riceve una strana lettera d'accettazione con relativa borsa di studio dal misterioso Cassel College, negli Stati Uniti. Il ragazzo respinge subito la lettera pensando sia una truffa, ma ben presto si rende conto che le persone della Cassel sono determinate a farlo iscrivere, costringendolo a scegliere fra la sua vita attuale e questa losca università. Mingfei, dopo una situazione imbarazzante creatasi nel tentativo di dichiarare la sua cotta, incontra Nono, una ragazza al secondo anno della Cassel che lo convince a iscriversi. Appena arrivato scopre dai professori la verità: i draghi esistono davvero e l'università è un'accademia dove ci si addestra per ucciderli. Lui, Lui, proprio come il resto degli studenti, è un ibrido umano che possiede geni di drago, e per questo dovrebbe manifestare abilità speciali ed uniche. Ma Mingfei sembra un normalissimo umano e rimane confuso quando gli viene assegnato il rango S e dichiarato un "talento senza precedenti" dal preside. Come non bastasse, a peggiorare tutta la situazione, inizia a ricevere delle visioni dove incontra un strano ragazzo.
info.title: Dragon Raja -The Blazing Dawn-

info.synopsis: La serie è ambientata nell’anno 2999, in cui due fazioni – TERRA e NESS – si stanno affrontando in una interminabile guerra intergalattica per controllare l’universo. Entrambe le fazioni sono dotate di navi spaziali, in grado di teletrasportare i piloti nella loro nave madre, prima di essere distrutte. In questo modo non ci sono vittime durante le battaglie. Dato che i riflessi delle persone del trentesimo secolo si sono notevolmente deteriorati, un ingegnere di TERRA, Curtis Lawson, utilizza una macchina del tempo per tornare indietro di mille anni, nel 1999 e reclutare quattro ragazze del passato per combattere per Terra. Queste sono Yohko Yamamoto, Momiji Kagariya, Ayano Elizabeth Hakuhouin e Madoka Midou
info.title: Starship Girl Yamamoto Yohko (TV)

info.synopsis: All'età di dodici anni Noor decide di allenarsi in montagna dopo essere stato rifiutato dai centri di formazione ufficiali della capitale in quanto ritenuto privo di talento. Il giovane è convinto che, con un duro allenamento, possa eguagliare i protagonisti delle storie della sua infanzia. Ma, per quanto determinato, conosce soltanto l’arte del bloccare i colpi che gli vengono inferti. Trascorsi degli anni, si specializza in tale tecnica diventandone maestro. Tuttavia, concluso l’allenamento, è deluso per non avere appreso altre tecniche necessarie per diventare un vero avventuriero. Non si è ancora reso conto di essere diventato uno dei più forti al mondo!
info.title: I Parry Everything

episodes.synopsis: “That’s a hassle.” That was second-year high schooler Nagi Seishiro’s favorite phrase as he lived his dull life. Until Mikage Reo, a classmate who dreamed of winning the World Cup, discovered Nagi’s hidden skill, inspiring him to play soccer and share his outstanding talent. One day, he receives an invitation to the mysterious BLUE LOCK Project. What awaits him there is an encounter with the finest strikers assembled from across the country. Nagi’s dream of becoming the best, alongside Reo, will take this prodigy to a world he’s never known. A prodigy can only be shaped when someone discovers him….now, striker Nagi Seishiro’s incredible talent and persona will set the soccer world ablaze.
episodes.title: Complete Movie

info.synopsis: La storia ci parla di Aoyama, un bambino che frequenta la quarta elementare, e di una misteriosa donna, un’igienista dentale, che diverrà la prima cotta del piccolo Aoyama. Ecco che tutto d’un tratto un gruppo di pinguini fa la sua comparsa in questo quartiere così calmo ed Aoyama si mette a lavoro per cercare di comprendere il motivo di questo strano fenomeno.
info.title: Penguin Highway

episodes.synopsis: Deeply touched by Mafuyu Sato's impressive voice, high school student Ritsuka Nakayama invited him to join him as a singer in his music group, alongside his friends Haruki Nakayama and Akihiko Kaji. With Mafuyu, Given's first concert was a real success, and also allowed Ritsuka to realize his feelings towards Mafuyu. After the two boys started dating, the young musicians' activities continued until they participated in a competition in which they did not win, but did not fail to attract the attention of many people. At the same time, Hiiragi Kashima, Mafuyu's childhood friend, and Shizusumi Yagi's group "syh", who notably won the competition in which Given failed, are preparing to make their debut. But due to the absence of its guitarist, the group finds itself blocked in its ascent. With his back against the wall, Hiiragi has only one solution: ask Ritsuka for help to temporarily assist them.
episodes.title: Hiiragi Mix

info.synopsis: In Sud America, il cacciatore Ryosuke (Ryo) insegue una bestia feroce che terrorizza i villaggi, ma dietro la caccia si cela un passato doloroso: la creatura è Bagi, una gatta geneticamente modificata con DNA umano che Ryo aveva cresciuto come un animale domestico e ritrovato anni dopo come una donna-gatto. Le origini di Bagi risalgono agli esperimenti della madre di Ryo, una scienziata che, per impedire la diffusione di un riso transgenico letale creato accidentalmente in laboratorio, decide di sacrificarsi affidando a Bagi l'ultimo campione da distruggere. Ryo, assistendo alla morte della madre senza conoscerne il contesto, si convince erroneamente che Bagi sia l'assassina e le dà la caccia per anni per vendetta. Quando finalmente la raggiunge nella giungla, Bagi ha ormai perso quasi tutta la sua umanità, ma un ciondolo lasciato dalla scienziata rivela a Ryo l'eroica verità; compreso il tragico malinteso, il giovane rinuncia ai suoi intenti e permette a Bagi di scomparire tra le montagne, sperando che possa finalmente vivere in pace lontano dalla civiltà umana.
info.title: Bagi, the Monster of Mighty Nature (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: アギャール将軍はこれまでライディーンを倒せなかった罪を問われ処刑されようとしていた。最後のチャンスを与えられたアギャールは一計を案じ、臨海学園の校長室に入り込み、洸に助けを乞う。洸はわなにはまり…。
episodes.title: Eroismo! La scossa mortale di Agyarll

episodes.synopsis: 史上最大のゴリラ、グレートゴングが逃走した。ゴングは捕まったが、その体は傷だらけだった。同情したマリは傷の手当てをするが、その後ゴングは妖魔帝国にさらわれ、巨獣ゴンガーとなって街を襲う。
episodes.title: Il ruggito della forza demoniaca di Gonger, la bestia gigante

episodes.synopsis: 突然ドローメに襲われた洸は、シャーキンからの手紙を発見する。それはアギャール将軍の葬儀の招待状だった。約束通り教会に行くとガンテが棺を運んでくるが、その中から現れたのはダルダン提督だった。
episodes.title: Crudeltà! Il demone ammiraglio Daldan

episodes.synopsis: 恐竜ティラノザウルスが翼を与えられ、ムチールとして蘇った。戦うライディーンは光の輪に囲まれ、パワーが弱って海へ墜落し、意識を失う。洸はガンテにとらわれ、ダルダンはムートロンの引き渡しを要求する。
episodes.title: Attacco devastante! La trappola della bestia alata Muchiru

episodes.synopsis: 神面岩が妖魔人たちから攻撃されたため、洸は急行する。化石獣コンドルンの妨害にもめげずフェードインするが、ダルダンの操るゴーガーとコンドルンの挟み撃ちに遭って倒せない。ドローメは再び神面岩を襲い…。
episodes.title: Attacco incessante! Gli artigli del demone uccello Condorun

episodes.synopsis: ダルダンはライディーンの姿を盗み撮りしたフィルムを分析して化石獣・鎌ギラーを作り上げ、ライディーンを危機に陥れる。一方、ムトロポリスと神面岩がドローメに襲われ、ダンたちはボインダーで妖魔軍団と戦う。
episodes.title: Le lame demoniache di Kamagira e l'attacco tonante di Moguron

episodes.synopsis: 吹雪と共に街を襲う化石獣キバコンゴ。長い牙でライディーンが襲撃され、洸はゴッドバードにチェンジして逃れるが、シャーキンはダルダンが撮影していた写真を元に、ゴッドバードを捕らえて砕く悪魔装置を作り…。
episodes.title: Il mostruoso attacco dei Kibango, i demoni bestia alterego

episodes.synopsis: 妖魔軍団が洸暗殺の命を受けて襲い掛かり、洸は視力を奪われてしまう。街には灼熱獣モドロスが現れ、洸はマリに頼んでスパーカーの操縦を任せてフェードイン。異常を察知したダルダンはモドロスを背後に回させる。
episodes.title: La fiamma della bestia incandescente Modoros

episodes.synopsis: 化石獣が次々と現れた。ダルダンに操られているダンにだまされ、洸たちは地底に生き埋めにされてしまう。知らせを受けたブルーガーが突破口を開き、洸は化石獣たちに包囲されたムトロポリスを救うため出撃する。
episodes.title: Il grande assalto infernale del demone bestia Gamelen

episodes.synopsis: シャーキンが妖魔通信を洸の元へ送る。そこには、火山島の十字架にはりつけにされた父・一郎の姿があった。ライディーンは島に待ち受けていたダルダン提督を倒し、巨大化したシャーキンとの一騎打ちが始まる。
episodes.title: La battaglia del demone Sharkin

episodes.synopsis: バラオが豪雷巨烈と激怒巨烈の兄弟を呼んだ。そして、洸の元に豪雷の巨烈獣コーカツが襲い掛かる。数々の武器を使いこなすコーカツに対して洸は反撃に転じるが、それたコーカツのミサイルが神面岩の地底を直撃する。
episodes.title: La furia delle belve infernali!

episodes.synopsis: 激怒の巨烈獣レーザルと対峙したブルーガーの神宮寺は怪光線を照射され、一時的に視力を失ってしまい、洸も同じ光線で目をやられてしまった。ブルーガーの必死の活躍で何とか逃れたものの、ダメージは大きかった。
episodes.title: Distruggi Lesar, la belva dai sette occhi!

episodes.synopsis: 孤独な洸に母のぬくもりを味わってもらおうと、レッド団はダンの母親を連れて来た。しかし、敵のガンマーがそれを狙い撃ちし、ライディーンと洸は彼らをかばって右肩に重傷を負う。さらに右腕を執拗に狙われ…。
episodes.title: La mostruosa potenza di Ganmer, il frantuma crani

episodes.synopsis: 麗が去ったコープランダー隊は神宮寺が1人で出撃する。マリがブルーガーにこっそり乗り込んでいたが、足手まといにしかならない。やがてライディーンは巨烈獣テツダンによって絶体絶命のピンチに追い込まれる。
episodes.title: Il terrificante lancio a testa in giù di Tetsudan

episodes.synopsis: ムートロン受信装置を作る猿丸の両親が故郷から訪ねてくることに。両親の乗った汽車が通る街を巨烈獣ドライガーが襲い、両親は助かったものの、ドライガーのミサイルがライディーンの心臓部に食い込んでしまった。
episodes.title: Draiger, operazione frantuma cuore

episodes.synopsis: 怪力を持つ巨烈獣クラッシュをライディーンが破壊したが、その破片は消えていた。その様子を見に行ったアッちゃんに謎の影が迫る。一方、猿丸はうなされるアッちゃんの夢から11人のロボットを見つけ出した。
episodes.title: La belva devastatrice e il segreto degli Undici

episodes.synopsis: サッカー部の練習を応援に来たレッド団の母親たちの姿を前に、洸は母への思いをかきたてられていた。そんな時、車にはねられた洸は通りすがりの女性に助けられる。洸は彼女との団欒に安らぎを感じていた。
episodes.title: La misterosa arma segreta di Galjer

episodes.synopsis: 激怒巨烈はバラオの命令を無視してサラマンダーで出撃した。洸は炎熱とライディーンに食い込むウロコに苦戦する。猿丸は、サラマンダーにはどんなものでもエネルギーに変えてしまう装置が付いていると推察した。
episodes.title: Le fiamme del drago incandescente Salamander

episodes.synopsis: 記憶喪失の転校生・岬百合香は洸を慕うようになっていく。そんな中、現れる巨烈獣マダンガーはいくら倒しても復活する。その心臓は百合香の体内に埋め込まれていた。百合香の秘密を知った洸は戦えなくなってしまう。
episodes.title: L'arciere infernale Madanger

episodes.synopsis: 世界グランプリレースに出場することになった洸は、ウルフ西城との勝負を楽しみにしていたが、ウルフは妹を人質に取られ、妖魔軍団への協力を強要されていた。レース当日、ウルフが巨烈獣に乗って攻撃してきた。
episodes.title: Zaikron, attacco al Gran Prix

episodes.synopsis: いつも戦いの足を引っ張ってばかりいるレッド団は東山所長に叱られ、ボインダーの出動を禁じられていた。そこへ現れる巨烈獣ダングスは、周囲の建物を体に取り込んでパワーの源にする恐ろしい相手だった。
episodes.title: Distruggi Dangs, la bestia demoniaca autorigenerante!

episodes.synopsis: ロボット競争に参加したボインダーは巨烈獣ギガールに襲われ、アッちゃんが人質に取られてしまう。激怒はアッちゃんと引きかえに洸に1対1の勝負を挑むが、フェードアウトした隙にライディーンをさらってしまう。
episodes.title: Gli artigli della bestia uccello malefica Gigarl

episodes.synopsis: ムトロポリスが正月を迎え、久しぶりの休暇を楽しむ洸たちは、のすけの家で百人一首を見学していた。そこへジェットクロスが出現し、柔らかい装甲をライディーンの武器に巻きつけて爆破してしまう。
episodes.title: Jet Cross, il demone assassino oscuro

episodes.synopsis: 巨烈兄弟の巨烈獣の力が互角と見たバラオは2体を合体させ、合体獣ガードンをライディーンにぶつけた。あまりの巨大さにライディーンも容易に手が出せない。ライディーンは大原山の火口に落とされ、洸は気を失う。
episodes.title: La trappola della possente belva combinata Gardon

episodes.synopsis: 猿丸が新たな武器を装着しようとしたが、ライディーンは受け付けない。そのため合体獣サンドキラーとは既存の武器で戦うしかない。その時、コンピューターがライディーンに隠された兵器の存在を教えるが…。
episodes.title: Sand Killer, la terrificante tempesta di sabbia

episodes.synopsis: 猿丸がライディーンの武器を改良して4つのパワーアップを考えた。その時、合体獣シャーゴンが現れブルーガーを飲み込んでしまう。危機が迫るブルーガーを救出すべく、パワーアップされたライディーンが立ち上がる。
episodes.title: Shargon, la belva assassina combinata

episodes.synopsis: 激怒のキバマタと豪雷のビガーダがムトロポリスに迫るが、兄弟の仲間割れによってキバマタは引き上げた。激怒がキバマタを修理している間に、豪雷のビガーダがライディーンを髪でからめ取り、凍らせてしまう。
episodes.title: L'attacco incandescente di Kibagarda

episodes.synopsis: ムーの紋章が記された空飛ぶ帆船が日本を目指していた。バラオはムートロンを求めて合体獣を出動させる。ムートロンエネルギーを解放するにはライディーン、ラムーの星、そして母・レムリアの念動力が必要だった。
episodes.title: Il Dio della morte Gilmolar e la forbice demoniaca

episodes.synopsis: ムーの歴史を知る洸。1万2千年前、ムー帝国はムートロンを狙う妖魔の襲撃を受けたのだ。王・ラムーはバラオが蘇る日のために娘・レムリアを人工冬眠させ、ライディーンをピラミッドへ、ラムーの星を南海へ封じた。
episodes.title: Il patibolo demoniaco di Gabilorn

episodes.synopsis: レムリアは神面岩の地底のムートロンを解放するため、ラムーの星を目覚めさせた。バリアを張った船はラムーの星を積み込んだが、激怒のメカガンテに捕まる。ライディーンは激怒を倒し、メカガンテから母を救出した。
episodes.title: Il grido infernale di furia Gekido

episodes.synopsis: 豪雷の指揮の下、最後の総力戦を仕掛けてきた。3体の巨烈獣をゴッドボイスで破壊したが、洸もライディーンも傷ついてもはや動けない。ついに、豪雷自ら巨大化し、巨烈獣バンガーとなって襲い掛かる。
episodes.title: L'attacco dell'armata di belve di Gourai

episodes.synopsis: バラオは鋼より強い自分の爪と髪から、守り竜バラゴーンを生み出しムトロポリスをこじ開け、人々を倒していく。神宮時は大型ミサイルをブルーガーに積み込み、単身バラゴーンの体内に飛び込んで自爆した。
episodes.title: L'ultima mossa di Barao

episodes.synopsis: 母にラムーの星を使わせまいと、洸はライディーンに乗り込んだ。しかし、バラオの吐く炎にはいかなる武器も通用せず、ついにレムリアはラムーの星を呼ぶ。母はライディーンにムートロンの力を与え、力尽きる。
episodes.title: Risplendi! L'invincibile Raideen

info.synopsis:
Prima serie d'animazione giapponese a presentare un robot di origini mistico/divine, Raideen è nota anche per aver introdotto il "colpo finale" del robot tramite cui sconfiggere i nemici.
Un giorno Akira Hibiki, un normale studente iscritto al club di calcio, sente una voce nella propria testa che lo spinge a entrare in una misteriosa piramide. Al suo interno, Akira viene a conoscenza di essere un discendente dell'antico popolo Mu e di essere l'unico in grado di salvare il pianeta dall'invasione di una razza di demoni Youma da poco risvegliatasi dal suo sonno millenario. Alla guida del robot gigante Raideen, un tempo protettore del continente Mu, Akira combatte i demoni per la salvezza della razza umana, aiutato nella sua impresa dagli amici del club di calcio e dalla figlia di un famoso scienziato, Mari Sakurano.
info.title: Il prode Raideen (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: Two mysterious aliens show up in town and Luna and Artemis restore Usagi's memories of being Sailor Moon
episodes.title: Un nuovo nemico per Sailor Moon

episodes.synopsis: Ali and En target a TV company who have invited Ami, Rei, Makoto, Minako and Naru for auditions. Luna and Artemis are forced to consider restoring the memories of the rest of the Sailor Team.
episodes.title: Le guerriere Sailor di nuovo insieme

episodes.synopsis: Makoto is forced to donate blood after her childhood friend is injured by a Cardian. Meanwhile, the mysterious Moonlight Knight appears in the midst of battle to help the Sailor Team.
episodes.title: Il cavaliere della Luna

episodes.synopsis: Usagi visits the new Virtual Reality Theatre with Mamoru unaware that it is the next target for Ali and En's energy harvesting operations.
episodes.title: Realtà virtuale o vera

episodes.synopsis: A powerful Cardian attacks a cherry blossom viewing party, and Sailor Moon is suddenly unable to fight it.
episodes.title: La festa dei fiori

episodes.synopsis: Minako becomes entangled with a kindergarten student who worships Sailor Moon, just as the aliens chose to target younger victims for their energy.
episodes.title: Il nuovo potere di Sailor Venus

episodes.synopsis: Ali and En are now targeting babies as a source of energy. When a baby's mother is attacked and in the hospital Mamoru and Usagi have to look after the child.
episodes.title: Baby sitter improvvisati

episodes.synopsis: Rei takes up songwriting for a school event. Ail and An target the event for its abundance of energy but end up getting parts in the play themselves.
episodes.title: Il debutto di Rea

episodes.synopsis: Makoto develops a crush on Seijuro while Ami investigates the possibility that he is the Moonlight Knight.
episodes.title: L'amore è…

episodes.synopsis: Some of Mamoru's college friends put on a production of Snow White and Usagi and her friends are only ones left to be in it. An assures she will be Snow White since Mamoru will be the prince, Ail becomes jealous and sends in a Cardian to attack.
episodes.title: Operazione biancaneve

episodes.synopsis: After Usagi is caught eating in class and An talks about to a teacher the two find themselves in detention and to survive An decides to steal her energy. Meanwhile, Ail faces off with the other Sailor Senshi using another Cardian.
episodes.title: Pericolo al doposcuola

episodes.synopsis: When the Makai Tree seems it is close to dying, Ail and An begin to steal even more energy but are horrified when the tree does not respond to the energy. Usagi pays the siblings a visit and is attacked by the Makai Tree.
episodes.title: L'albero misterioso

episodes.synopsis: The Sailor Guardians have to save Usagi and Mamoru from the Makai Tree and in the process, Ail and An find out Sailor Moon's true identity.
episodes.title: I misteri si svelano

episodes.synopsis: A strange child, claiming to be called Usagi Tsukino, appears from the sky and demands the Silver Crystal from Usagi.
episodes.title: La sosia misteriosa

episodes.synopsis: Mamoru begins to experience bizarre visions, which prompt him to break up with Usagi. Meanwhile, Berthier begins to spread Dark Power via a cosmetics store.
episodes.title: L'abbandono

episodes.synopsis: Ami considers leaving Japan and her life as a Sailor Guardian behind to study medicine abroad in Germany. Meanwhile, Berthier takes over Bob-Floy, an ice cream store, to spread Dark Power.
episodes.title: La borsa di studio

episodes.synopsis: Rei's grandfather tries to get more girls into the shrine, but Koan targets it in its role as a Star Point.
episodes.title: Muscoli e bellezza

episodes.synopsis: In an attempt to 'smoke' Chibi-Usa out, Petz's droid creates a thunderstorm in hopes it will cause her strong magical energy to the peak.
episodes.title: Il segreto di Chibiusa

episodes.synopsis: Makoto and Minako get into a fight and refuse to speak to each other, while Calaveras and Petz take over a Crystal Point, a fortune-telling and jewelry store, to spread dark power.
episodes.title: Liti per amore

episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Chibi-Usa decide to make curry together for a party at her school, but the Juban Supermarket becomes targeted by Calaveras and Petz.
episodes.title: Chi sa preparere il curry

episodes.synopsis: The Senshi go on vacation to a remote island, where Chibi-Usa makes a new friend.
episodes.title: Vacanze Esotiche

episodes.synopsis: Wiseman predicts that Chibi-Usa will appear, so Rubeus sends the Spectre Sisters to capture her, leading to a battle with the Sailor Team.
episodes.title: Proteggere Chibiusa

episodes.synopsis: Sailor Moon is attacked by a Droid who locks her in a nightmare, and the only one who can wake her is Tuxedo Mask.
episodes.title: Incubi

episodes.synopsis: Koan makes a final bid to kill Chibi-Usa, convinced she can win Rubeus' heart. However, she faces unexpected opposition from Sailor Mars, and is shocked to be rejected by Rubeus.
episodes.title: Delusioni di cuore

episodes.synopsis: Ami enters an international chess tournament at the Chess Tower, and discovers that Berthier has targeted the building.
episodes.title: La partita di scacchi

episodes.synopsis: Spurred on by Wiseman, Rubeus sends Calaveras and Petz on a suicide mission to kill the Sailor Senshi and Chibi-Usa.
episodes.title: Le quattro sorelle persecutrici

episodes.synopsis: After discovering that he is to be withdrawn, Rubeus resorts to desperate measures to kill Chibi-Usa, and succeeds in abducting the Sailor Team.
episodes.title: L'UFO

episodes.synopsis: With the rest of the Sailor Team captured by Rubeus, Sailor Moon plans a rescue, and is taken aboard the UFO for a final showdown.
episodes.title: Battaglia nello spazio

episodes.synopsis: Chibi-Usa becomes ill suddenly, her mind invaded by the power of the Evil Black Crystal. Sailor Pluto, a Sailor Senshi from the future, appears to the Sailor Team to offer her help.
episodes.title: Una nuova guerriera Sailor

episodes.synopsis: Esmeraude begins her attack on twentieth century Tokyo, attempting to nurture a Dark Henge on a Negative Point inside a cake shop.
episodes.title: La prima missione

episodes.synopsis: While Esmeraude targets the latest craze, promise rings, Usagi has a dream that may explain why Mamoru has been acting coldly towards her.
episodes.title: L'amore rinasce

episodes.synopsis: Esmeraude releases a virulent strain of influenza into Tokyo, and only Minako and Chibi-Usa seem unaffected.
episodes.title: L'influenza

episodes.synopsis: After Luna wounds his pride one too many times, Artemis sets out on a mission to prove his worth, and stumbles upon Esmeraude's latest plot.
episodes.title: Le avventure di Artemis

episodes.synopsis: Esmeraude attacks a local cram school, altering the behavior of the students there. When Ami investigates, she is subjected to a series of hallucinations by Esmeraude's Droid.
episodes.title: La copiona

episodes.synopsis: Esmeraude attacks two targets simultaneously, creating chaos in Chibi-Usa's school, and the Sailor Team face off against her two Droids.
episodes.title: Il potere di Chibiusa

episodes.synopsis: The Sailor Team accompany Chibi-Usa into the Space-Time Corridor, where they are attacked by Esmeraude and her Droid.
episodes.title: Futuro arriviamo!

episodes.synopsis: The Sailor Team arrive in the thirtieth century with Chibi-Usa, where they are met by King Endymion, Mamoru's future self.
episodes.title: La Luna Nera

episodes.synopsis: Chibi-Usa falls under the control of Wiseman, while Esmeraude resolves to kill Sailor Moon and win Prince Dimande's heart by any means necessary.
episodes.title: Il rimorso

episodes.synopsis: Chibi-Usa is kidnapped by Wiseman. Who brainwashes her into thinking her parents don't love her and transforms her into a villain called Black Lady.
episodes.title: La Lady Nera

episodes.synopsis: Saphir discovers that Wiseman has been plotting against the Black Moon Clan, and races to warn his brother of the betrayal.
episodes.title: L'inganno

episodes.synopsis: The Sailor Senshi go inside the growing Evil Black Crystal fragment, where Sailor Moon finally confronts Prince Dimande.
episodes.title: Diamond si ribella

episodes.synopsis: Sailor Moon faces Black Lady, as Wiseman prepares to fire the power of the Evil Black Crystal through the Dark Gate and destroy the Earth.
episodes.title: L'ultima battaglia

episodes.synopsis: The Sailor Team present a preview of the forthcoming season, and debate the prospect of selecting a new leader.
episodes.title: Prologo alla nuova battaglia

Allo scopo di nutrire questa pianta, i due alieni evocheranno dei mostri per potersi procurare prede umane, ma verranno subito ostacolati da Luna e Artemis che ripristineranno la memoria delle Guerriere Sailor. tvdb.synopsis: The movie takes place between episodes 36 and 37 of the TV series. Now that Mephisto has been freed from Noise's evil influence, he pays a visit to Ako with the intention of bringing her back to Major Land to live with her parents again. Ako, who misses her parents, agrees, but before they can leave, all the music suddenly disappears from Kanon Town. Upon arriving in Major Land where people are forced to play with no music coming out, Mephisto, Ako, and the other PreCure encounter Ako's childhood friend, Suzu, who claims that Aphrodite is allegedly responsible for stealing the world's music. As Hibiki, Kanade and Ellen escort Suzu to her home, Ako and Mephisto confront Aphrodite, who captures Ako and sends three servants called the Major Three after the others to try to obtain the Healing Chest. As they send a Negatone after the Cures, Suzu escapes with the Healing Chest. As the others struggle against the Major Three, Mephisto helps to free Ako by singing her favourite song, helping everyone realise music that comes from the heart and allowing the Cures to defeat the Major Three. Aphrodite reveals she is being possessed by an evil known as Howling, becoming willing to sacrifice herself so that Howling can be destroyed with her. Not willing to kill Aphrodite, Mephisto forces Howling to leave Aphrodite's body. As Howling overwhelms the PreCure, Suzu and the other citizens use their power to help them, restoring everyone to normal. Howling transforms into his true form and captures Kanade, Hibiki's unwillingness to give up grants her the power to become Crescendo Cure Melody and together with the others manages to defeat Howling. Afterwards, Ako decides to stay in Kanon Town with the other PreCures.
tvdb.title: Suite PreCure♪ the Movie: Take it Back! The Miraculous Melody that Connects Hearts

info.synopsis: Yūki si sveglia e si ritrova in una misteriosa villa, con indosso un'uniforme da cameriera e sdraiata su un lussuoso letto. Mentre indaga su quello che è successo arriva nella sala da pranzo e si ritrova davanti altre cinque ragazze che hanno lo stesso vestito. Presto questo gruppo scoprirà che l'unico modo per sopravvivere è quello di superare tutte le trappole all'interno dell'edificio: giochi mortali pieni di cerbottane, seghe circolari, stanze chiuse e armi letali. Una situazione senza speranza e terrificante per tutti i presenti... tranne per Yūki. Dopottutto lei, nonostante la giovane età, è una professionista di questi giochi mortali che si guadagna da vivere grazie ai premi in denaro che vince in queste violente competizioni. E anche questa volta non ha intenzione di farsi scappare questa opportunità...
info.title: Shiboyugi: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table (ITA)

info.synopsis: Ryūsei Narukami è un giovane NEET che in realtà è la reincarnazione di un potente Re Demone di un altro mondo. Meteor Hanaori, una liceale, è invece l'eroina che in passato lo aveva sconfitto. Entrambi rinati, si ritrovano di nuovo faccia a faccia quando Ryūsei diventa insegnante nella scuola di Hanaori. Il loro rapporto oscilla tra rivalità e attrazione, mentre i ricordi della vita precedente riemergono e li costringono a fare i conti con ciò che sono stati e con i sentimenti che, questa volta, rischiano di trasformare la loro "lotta" in qualcosa di molto diverso.

Consumato dal senso di colpa, Peru inizia un viaggio con l'obiettivo di distruggere tutte le maschere leggendarie che erano state create dal suo maestro, finendo per incrociare il proprio cammino con alleati improbabili e nemici mortali.
